newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai SEC studies more ECDs disclosure requirement.
newsitem.headline: Thai SEC studies more ECDs disclosure requirement.

text.p: Thailand's Securities and Exchange Commission said on Tuesday it was studying plans to require local issuers of Euro Covertible debentures to disclose more information related to their issues to the public.
If any information related to the ECDs negatively affected issuers, they would be required to also disclose that information to potential local investors, an SEC spokeswoman told Reuters.
Details of the planned measures were not ready yet.
"It's just an idea. The SEC will conduct further studies to see whether the measures will have an adverse effect on the public," said spokeswoman Ruenvadee Suwanmongkol.
Currently, the SEC has no rules to force ECD issuers to disclose information related to their ECDs to local investors.
